EXPLORE
WASD / arrows to walk. Mouse or drag to look. Shift to run. E to sit or play. Tab for the grand hall.
TAKE A SEAT
Choose a table from the welcome panel, click it in the room, or press 1–7. Click a fruit machine, approach it and press E, or use Machines to choose any of the five games. Escape returns to the floor when the current hand allows it.
PLAY HERE
Connecting to a machine keeps your camera, movement and the casino ambience. Space plays, Q opens the controls, and E or Escape disconnects. Walk away to disconnect automatically after the current spin. Cabinet view and Screen view are optional; Play here returns you to your place.
BE SEEN
Anyone can watch: the Room button shows who is here. Join with one free wallet signature (Leather or Xverse) and everyone else sees your Adrian at your seat, with a name tag showing your BNS name or a short version of your address. Stand up or walk away and your Adrian goes with you. If you only watch, nobody sees you. The signature sends no transaction, costs no fee and cannot spend anything, and the room never moves any money. Leave the room any time from the same panel.
CONNECTING TO SPACES
Every table seat and every fruit machine is a space. Sitting down or connecting to a machine puts you in that space for everyone in the room. Each space holds one person: if someone already has the seat you pick, you are given a free one at the same table. Being seen in a space reserves nothing and changes no game: your hand, spins and LAYR stay between you and the table or machine. The Afterglow Bar stools are not part of the room yet.
LIVE CHAT
Signed-in players can talk. Press Chat (💬 on a phone) to type. What people say floats down the side of the screen, newest at the bottom, and stays there; while the chat is open you can scroll back through everything said since you joined. Hide chat tucks it away and Move right puts it on the other side. Tap a name, or Here now, to send that person a direct message (marked “→ you” when it is for you), block them or report them. Messages are not secret: they pass through the room service, so never share anything sensitive. Each is up to 280 characters, with no links, one every two seconds. The room saves nothing (only a report, if someone sends one); your browser keeps this session's chat in this tab and clears it when you leave the room or close the tab. Blocking works both ways: neither of you can reach the other. Guests can see who is here but cannot chat.
THE AFTERGLOW BAR
Click Bar, press B, or approach the counter and press E. Order cocktails and snacks from Adrian. Purchases use your shared LAYR balance. Your round stays on the bar after you close the menu; choose a serving to enjoy a sip or bite.
GET LAYR
Two dispensers serve the entrance and lounge. Click one, approach and press E, or choose Get LAYR. Connect your Stacks testnet wallet. A plain STX transfer goes to the configured house address; the testnet API verifies it before crediting LAYR in your browser at 100,000 per STX, for 1–10 STX. Recover an already paid transfer by its transaction ID. Each transfer can credit the shared casino balance once.
ON MOBILE
Drag the left side to move and the right side to look. Tap the sit button when near a table.
LAYR
Practice chips only. No wallet connection or deposits. The salon follows the existing local testnet simulation.
